args.message: All five of the top products by units sold in 2025 are beverages. Tangaroo sold the most at 93,483 units, followed by vanilla ice (93,458), for richer or pourover (93,371), adele-ade (93,243) and chai and mighty (92,952). The gap from first to fifth is only about 0.6%. The best-selling jaffle is nutellaphone who dis?, in 6th place with 28,396 units. I counted one items row as one unit, using orders placed in calendar year 2025. The data doesn't support the business-rule note that chai and mighty is #1 by units in 2025: it ranks 5th. The name "for richer or pourover " is shown exactly as stored, including a trailing space.
